integrity: Proof steps, stated formulas and finite checks are supplied. Verification is finite and does not stand in for the general theorem.
scientific_limitations: The result is for labeled alphabets q>=3 and Hamming distance exactly two, uses the established two-shift almost-commutation lemma, and is not independently audited; equivalent unindexed prior formulas remain a risk. The binary necklace case is credited to existing literature.
title: Exact q-ary census of cyclic rotations at Hamming distance two
